definitions.explanation: The fleshy back part of the lower leg, between the knee and the ankle.

examples.japanese: ふくらはぎ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧つった。
examples.english: I got a cramp in my calf.

examples.japanese: ⟦{走|はし}った→走る：00519_hashiru⟧⟦{後|あと}→後：09580_ato⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧ふくらはぎ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦ストレッチ→ストレッチ：05239_sutorecchi⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I stretch my calves after running.

examples.japanese: ⟦{長時間|ちょうじかん}→長時間：10165_choujikan⟧⟦{座|すわ}っている→座る：00757_suwaru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、ふくらはぎ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦むくむ→むくむ：07354_mukumu⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Sitting for long periods can cause swelling in the calves.

notes:
ふくらはぎ refers to the fleshy back part of the lower leg. Always written in hiragana.

ETYMOLOGY:
From ⟦{膨|ふく}らむ→膨らむ：05342_fukuramu⟧ (to swell) + はぎ ({脛|はぎ}, shin/lower leg). Named for the rounded, swelling shape of the calf muscle.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ふくらはぎ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧つる: to get a calf cramp
- ふくらはぎ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{筋肉|きんにく}→筋肉：02646_kinniku⟧: calf muscles
- ふくらはぎ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧もむ: to massage the calves
- ふくらはぎ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦ストレッチ→ストレッチ：05239_sutorecchi⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to stretch the calves
- ふくらはぎ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦むくむ→むくむ：07354_mukumu⟧: calves become swollen

HEALTH NOTE:
The calf is sometimes called the 「{第二|だいに}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{心臓|しんぞう}→心臓：03262_shinzou⟧」 (second heart) in Japanese health discourse, because the calf muscles help pump blood from the legs back to the heart. Calf massage and exercises are commonly recommended for circulation.
